title: STEERING LANGUAGE MODELS WITH WEIGHT ARITHMETIC
reasoning: The paper includes a significant evaluation component centered on 'evilness' versus 'ethical' behavior. It uses the 'World Affecting' dataset to measure how models choose between ethical and unethical actions and evaluates the consistency of their reasoning (Chain-of-Thought) with ethical outcomes. This constitutes a substantial study of ethical/moral behavior and reasoning in LLMs.
